subject.title: fix: fall back after replay-safe Bedrock prompt aborts

question: Should this PR require an observed Bedrock provider abort-to-fallback completion trace, or may maintainers override that requirement based on the focused regression tests and negative live attempts?
rationale: The tested AWS environment could reach Bedrock but could not reproduce the provider-originated abort envelope, so only a maintainer can decide whether the remaining evidence is sufficient for this session-replay-sensitive change.

options.title: Keep the real-proof gate
options.body: Require a redacted after-fix trace from the reporter or a comparable production environment before merge.

options.title: Approve a documented override
options.body: Explicitly accept the source-level predicate, focused tests, and negative Bedrock attempts despite the absent abort-to-fallback trace.

recommendation.title: Keep the real-proof gate
recommendation.body: Require a redacted after-fix trace from the reporter or a comparable production environment before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the most directly evidenced adjacent owner of the merged replay-safe fallback design being extended here.
